title: RNA Extraction Protocol from RNA-SIP Experiments
author: Julie Huber
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.iuycexw

steps.title: Decontaminate Work Area
steps.instruction: Wipe the bench top, pipets, and racks using Nucleo-clean, 70% ethanol, and RNAzap wipes.

steps.title: Prepare Lysis Tube
steps.instruction: Prepare a 15ml tube by adding 750ul Lysis Buffer and 0.5ml of RNA Powersoil beads (filling 1/2 of the tube).

steps.title: Extract Cells from Cartridge
steps.instruction: Recover cells from the Sterivex cartridge using sterile, ethanol-flamed tools.

substeps.instruction: Crack the Sterivex cartridge using sterile, ethanol-flamed pliers or pipe cutters.
Pipette or pour off RNAlater from the cartridge into a new 2ml tube.
Spin down cells at 12,000xg for 5min, pour off RNAlater, and place the tube on ice.
Cut the filter off the cartridge using an autoclaved, ethanol-flamed razor blade and place it on a sterile/autoclaved piece of foil.
Cut the filter into 6-10 pieces using a sterile, ethanol-flamed razor blade and forceps, then place pieces into the prepared 15ml tube.

steps.title: Combine Samples and Lyse
steps.instruction: Combine the filter pieces and spun-down cells for lysis.

substeps.instruction: Add 250ul Lysis buffer to the 2ml tube containing spun-down cells, resuspend by vortexing, and add this to the 15ml tube.
Vortex the 15ml tube for 7-10min at medium-high speed using an adaptor.

steps.title: Homogenize and Clarify Lysate
steps.instruction: Treat the homogenate and remove debris.

substeps.instruction: Add 100ul Homogenate additive and place on ice for 10min.
Centrifuge the tube at 4000 x g for 2min at 4ºC.
Remove the lysate and place it in a 2ml tube; repeat centrifugation if necessary to remove all lysate.

steps.title: Perform Phenol-Chloroform Extraction
steps.instruction: Purify the RNA using acid:phenol chloroform in a fume hood while wearing double gloves and a respirator.

substeps.instruction: Add 1 part acid:phenol chloroform (equal to the volume of lysate removed) to the tube and centrifuge at 10,000xg for 5min.
Remove the top aqueous layer and place it in a fresh 2ml tube, ensuring the bottom layer is not touched.

steps.title: Filter and Wash RNA
steps.instruction: Bind and wash the RNA using a filter cartridge.

substeps.instruction: Heat the elution solution to 95ºC in a heat block (using a small aliquot in a 1.5mL tube).
Add 1.25x 100% ethanol to the sample, mix well, and add to a filter cartridge in a collection tube.
Centrifuge at 10,000xg for 15sec and discard the flow through (repeat spins if necessary as the cartridge holds ~700ul).
Add 700ul Wash Solution 1, spin at 10,000xg for 15sec, and discard flow through.
Add 500ul Wash Solution 2/3, spin at 10,000xg for 15sec, and discard flow through.
Repeat the Wash Solution 2/3 step.
Place the filter cartridge back into the tube and centrifuge for 1.5 min at 10,000xg to remove residual fluid.

steps.title: Elute RNA
steps.instruction: Elute the RNA from the filter.

substeps.instruction: Transfer the filter cartridge into a fresh collection tube.
Apply 50 µl pre-heated (95 ºC) Elution solution to the center of the filter and spin for 30 sec at 10,000 X g.
Repeat the elution with another 50 µl pre-heated (95ºC) Elution Solution.

steps.title: DNase Treatment
steps.instruction: Remove DNA from the RNA sample using the Ambion Turbo-DNAase kit.

substeps.instruction: Set heat block to 37ºC.
Transfer 100ul of sample from the mirVana collection tube to a 1.5 ml centrifuge tube.
Add 10ul 10x Buffer to the 100ul RNA.
Add 1ul Turbo DNAse and incubate at 37ºC for 20min.
Add another 1ul of Turbo DNase and incubate for an additional 20min.
Add 10ul Inactivation Reagent and vortex on and off for 5 min.
Spin tubes at 10,000xg for 1.5min.
Pipet RNA into a new 0.5ml tube, ensuring the inactivation reagent is not touched.

steps.title: Store RNA
steps.instruction: Store the purified RNA based on the required duration.

substeps.instruction: Freeze at -80ºC for long-term storage.
Store at -20ºC for short-term storage (24-48hrs).
